entry.title: BILL011(26) (Honolulu): Returned approved.
entry.content:
RELATING TO AFFORDABLE HOUSING INCENTIVES.

Requires the HLM to submit semiannual reports detailing all types of incentives, along with the total amount and value of each incentive, received by every affordable housing project that has received one or more incentives from the City, State of Hawaii, and federal government, if applicable.

Latest action: Returned approved.

entry.title: BILL040(26) (Honolulu): Returned approved.
entry.content:
RELATING TO REAL PROPERTY TAXATION.

Temporarily entitles the owner of certain owner-occupied condominium units to a real property tax home exemption. Applies retroactively to the tax year beginning July 1, 2025, and thereafter.

Latest action: Returned approved.

View on the council site

entry.title: New: BILL065(26) (Honolulu) — INTRO
entry.content:
RELATING TO REAL PROPERTY TAXATION.

Amends the requirements for the historic residential real property dedicated for preservation exemption to provide that historic residential real property may not be used as a transient vacation unit. Applies to tax years beginning July 1, 2028; provided that historic residential real properties that have already been approved prior to the effective date of the ordinance will continue for the duration of the approved or renewed 10-year period, but may only be renewed if such properties comply with ROH Section 8-10.19 as it reads on the date of renewal.

Latest action: Introduced.
